recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the approved core-page wording without reintroducing redundant as() documentation or changing the FHIR-specific ofType guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-40270 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to remove mention of an as() function from fhirpath.html because as is operator syntax rather than an ofType() alias, and to update ofType(type : identifier) and the "This works the same..." prose to the base-spec-aligned type-specifier wording.
initial_application: No FHIR-40270-tagged commit was present on the combined branch. Related source history had already removed the core as()/alias mention and duplicate function section through FHIR-53208, and FHIR-41595 had corrected the polymorphism example from as to ofType, but the remaining ofType() section still had the old signature spacing and malformed relationship sentence.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes fhirpath.html as the FHIRPath page, confirming the edited source is in build scope. FHIR-I 2025-10-27 minutes confirm the work group understood that as() had already been removed from core and approved changing the ofType wording; no direct Zulip discussion for FHIR-40270 was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhirpath.html so the ofType heading reads ofType(type: type specifier) and the relationship sentence reads "This is as defined in the base FHIRPath specification," while preserving the FHIR-specific constraints that follow.
source_changes: source/fhirpath.html: changed the ofType() heading from "ofType(type : type specifier)" to "ofType(type: type specifier)".
source/fhirpath.html: changed "This is as defined as in the base FHIRPath specification" to "This is as defined in the base FHIRPath specification".
